rules.name: ouat178-security-history
rules.sql: SELECT table_name, create_time, update_time, table_rows FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND table_name IN ('security_info_table_cfs', 'cloned_security_info_table_cfs', 'helper_dbtodw_deal_ticket_security_info_table_cfs', 'deal_ticket_table_cfs', 'var_price_vol_table', 'vol_id_table') ORDER BY table_name
SELECT * FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs WHERE security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' ORDER BY security_id
SELECT * FROM dbsystemuat.helper_dbtodw_deal_ticket_security_info_table_cfs WHERE security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' LIMIT 30
